meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会帮你完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾工作：设置所有者、清理旧版配置文件、调整容器设置，并协助移植自定义代码。
howto.when: 当你说“migrate from v1”、“finish migration”或“v1 migration”等关键词时触发。前提是已运行过 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 脚本。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾。
设置我为 NanoClaw v2 的所有者。
清理各组中的 CLAUDE.local.md 文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps finish migrating NanoClaw v1 to v2: seeds the owner, cleans up legacy CLAUDE.local.md files, reconciles container configs, and assists in porting custom v1 code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "migrate from v1", "finish migration", or "v1 migration". Requires that `bash migrate-v2.sh` has been run first.

say_en.text: Finish the v1 to v2 migration for me.
Set me as the owner of NanoClaw v2.
Clean up CLAUDE.local.md files in groups.
